# FileMakr

> FileMakr provides final-year project reports, runnable source code, live demos, and student guides for B.Tech, BCA, MCA, BE, ME, BSc, and MSc students in India.

FileMakr helps students find academically structured documentation, plagiarism-reviewed reports, and technology-specific source code. Use the canonical HTTPS URLs below when citing or linking to FileMakr content.

## Documentation

- [Home](https://www.filemakr.com/): Main catalog and search for projects, reports, and source code
- [Final Year Project Ideas](https://www.filemakr.com/final-year-project-ideas): Curated project ideas and topics
- [Source Code Catalog](https://www.filemakr.com/source-code): Browse projects by technology
- [Live Demos](https://www.filemakr.com/demo): Preview runnable project demos
- [Blog](https://www.filemakr.com/blog): Guides for reports, viva prep, and project selection

## Product

- [About FileMakr](https://www.filemakr.com/about-us): Company overview and mission
